build_dictionary_from_text: build a DictionaryAgent to tokenize text and convert strings to vectors of token indices
convert_text_to_vector: convert a string to a vector of token indices using the DictionaryAgent txt2vec method
convert_vector_to_text: convert a vector of token indices back to text using the DictionaryAgent vec2txt method
load_save_dictionary: load a pre-existing dictionary from file or save the current dictionary to a file
find_ngrams_in_text: find ngrams up to size N in text that appear in a given token dictionary
